name: asc-cli-usage
title_zh: App Store 上架操作先问过它的命令行老司机
tagline_zh: 分页、鉴权、输出格式、参数歧义——它都提前替你踩过坑。写 asc 命令前先问它，少翻三页文档，少试错五次。
tagline_en: Pagination, auth, output formats, flag ambiguities—it's been burned so you don't have to. Ask before writing asc.
desc_en: Guidance for using asc cli in this repo (flags, output formats, pagination, auth, and discovery). Use when asked to run or design asc commands or interact with App Store Connect via the CLI.
why_zh: 不是背参数，是懂这套 CLI 的脾气：知道哪个 flag 会静默截断、哪种输出要配 jq 才可读。
why_en: It doesn't recite flags—it knows the CLI's temper: which flag silently truncates, which output needs jq to be readable, which.
limit_zh: 只认本仓库内 asc CLI 的用法；不覆盖 App Store Connect 网页后台操作，也不解释苹果审核政策。
limit_en: Only covers asc CLI usage in this repo; no web portal walkthroughs, no App Review policy advice. Outside CLI interaction scope, it will flat-out say.
title_en: Ask the CLI veteran before touching App Store Connect
